import html from typing import List # Template for a user post. Placeholders are replaced using .format(). USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_title}

by {username}

{post_body}
{tags_html}
""" def render_user_post(username: str, post_title: str, post_body: str, tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Render a user-generated post safely for inclusion in HTML. Parameters ---------- username : str Name of the user who created the post. post_title : str Title of the post. post_body : str Main content of the post. tags : list[str] List of tags added by the user. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML representation of the post. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to prevent XSS / injection safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=False) # Preserve line breaks # Escape tags individually and wrap them in escaped_tags = [f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tags] tags_html = ' '.join(escaped_tags) return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, post_title=safe_title, post_body=safe_body, tags_html=tags_html )
